description: Reorganize the payout system codebase to improve maintainability and structure. This involves consolidating payout-related logic into dedicated modules while maintaining all existing functionality. The reorganization should make the codebase easier to navigate and extend for future payout features.
functional_requirements: Create a dedicated payout utilities module that consolidates payout-related helper functions
Reorganize payout processing logic into a clear separation between creation, processing, and state management
Maintain all existing payout functionality including Stripe, PayPal, and stablecoin payout methods
Ensure payout reminder system continues to work with all supported payout statuses
Keep all payout configuration parameters accessible and configurable
Preserve all webhook handlers and API endpoints for payout-related operations
